oracle.invariant: S1: 404 on everything of account A. S2: refused (SSRF), nothing fetched. S3: one opportunity (201 then 200); exactly one executor claims the job; the expired lease is reclaimed and the job completes. S4: the worker refuses before anything is created: the demo action reads failed TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE, no wo_build row, no create-site request. S5: no pictures and no throw in every case; the site is built as without the feature. S6: the second run reads the kept plan and places the same pictures. S7: the prompt names each CMS's look doors (Joomla `templates/<template>/css/custom.css`, the template style's colour and font settings or inline styles; WordPress the Customizer's Additional CSS, the theme's own settings or inline styles, never custom.css) as the doors NOT to change colours through; for Joomla, WordPress and EmDash it keeps the template's bound design system and allows only layout CSS as plain CSS, never editing, rebuilding or replacing the template's compiled CSS or its SCSS.
